Captures shred, repair, gossip, and replay data to CSV and binary files.

# Purpose
This file defines the `scap` tile, which is a capture and export component in the `fd_stem` tile framework. It watches several input links, including `net_shred`, `repair_net`, `shred_out`, `gossip_out`, `repair_scap`, and `replay_out`, and writes selected data to CSV or binary files. The tile records shred traffic, repair requests, FEC completion events, and peer contact information in CSV form. It also writes repair shred slices and replay bank hash records in binary form so other tools can reproduce or analyze replay activity.

The file also handles manifest loading and stake weight publication. When a manifest path is set, it reads and parses the snapshot manifest, updates the root slot watermark, publishes the manifest on an output link, and generates stake weight messages for the current and next epoch. The code defines the tile context, memory layout, seccomp policy, file setup, and fragment callbacks used by `fd_stem`. It is therefore a tile implementation file, not a public header, and it provides the full runtime behavior for the capture tile.
